summary: Frontend-only verification of hero logo sharpness fix. All DOM/style-level fix criteria PASS: img src contains '@3x' (Logo_6_v2_Final@3x.png), naturalWidth=990, naturalHeight=354, computed mix-blend-mode='normal' (was 'screen'), imageRendering='-webkit-optimize-contrast', decoding='async'. Display sizes correct: h-48 (192px) at 1280px viewport and h-36 (144px) at 375px viewport. No console errors related to the logo. Home page hero, header, CTAs (SHOP / MEMBERS / HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS), and 'RECOVER LIKE THE PROS DO' all render.
critical_code_review_comments: Regression note (not a new bug): Rapid consecutive navigations during route sweep triggered HTTP 429 responses on /wholesale, /recovery-services, /contact from the preview infra rate limiter. Individually the routes load fine (also confirmed by /membership, /shop, /doctors, /affiliates returning 200 earlier in the same sweep). Not related to the logo fix.

Fonts: repeated 'OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion' warnings from Google Fonts (Open Sans) on every page. Pre-existing and unrelated to this bug, but worth self-hosting or verifying the <link> URL formatting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero logo fix verified in DOM. If perceptual sharpness feedback is still received, consider serving an SVG version of the logo instead of a rasterized 3x PNG for true edge crispness at all DPRs. Also consider self-hosting Open Sans to remove noisy font decode warnings.
